acceptance_criteria: A missing or incapable executor cannot yield an unowned success acknowledgement.
An occupied slot creates durable worker-consumable queued work.
Provisioning or send failure records a retryable or terminal disposition.
Restart resumes queued work exactly once.
Duplicate suppression applies only to canonically active work.
Health distinguishes observed zero from unreadable repair storage.
